data.title: bn-2gus: tolerate volatile parent-dir timestamps in path chains
data.description: Fix exit-2 fail-stop 'children execution tools dev-null live identity differs' caused by /dev (devtmpfs) directory timestamps changing during the build. Compare path chains on structural anti-swap identity only (device/inode/mode/uid/gid/type/path); node identity + file sha256 stay strict. Same class as bn-1csq. Verified against the exact stale v17 record; runner self-test 163/163.

data.reason: APPROVED. Security preserved: _chain_structural keeps device, inode, mode, uid, gid, type, path — the fields a symlink/bind swap of / or /dev would alter; only volatile changed_ns/modified_ns/size/link_count are dropped, which devtmpfs mutates on any device event. /dev/null node identity (major 1 minor 3, mode 0666, root:root, nlink 1) and file sha256 pins remain strict. Matches bn-1csq precedent. Verified accepts the exact stale v17 /dev record; runner self-test 163/163. open_findings=0
